venue: MVSR Engineering College Nadergul Campus, Hyderabad, Telengana, India
title: IEEE SAC Hyderabad Section, in association with GyanNidhi Innovations (GNI), Unistring Tech Solutions (UTS), IEEE SB MVSR EC, IEEE SB VNRVJIET |a 2-Day Workshop on Electronics Product Manufacturing Quality Standards.
description:
“Quality is never an accident; it is always the result of intelligent effort.”

IEEE SAC Hyderabad Section, in association with GyanNidhi Innovations (GNI), Unistring Tech Solutions (UTS), IEEE SB MVSR Engineering College, and Student Network Team, invites you to a 2-Day Workshop on Electronics Product Manufacturing Quality Standards.

Congratulations to the students who secured internships and jobs through previous GNI courses and workshops.

Date: 16th & 17th March 2026
Timings: 10:00 AM – 4:30 PM
Mode: Physical and Online
Physical: MVSR Engineering College, Nadergul Campus & others online

Certification will be awarded only to students who attend the session and complete the relevant GNI course.

Completion of the Electronic QA/QC course is mandatory to attend the workshop.

Day 1 – 16th March 2026
Component & PCB Quality Control
• Prerequisite GNI Course: PCB QA & Reliability – Modules 7, 8, 9, 11, 12
• Industrial QC Standards & Workflow
• ESD Safety Practices
• QC Instrumentation Basics
• Bare PCB Inspection – Fabrication Defects & IPC-A-600 Inspection
• PCB Assembly Inspection (SMT/THT)
• Inspection & Solder Joint Analysis (IPC-A-610)
• PCB BOM Packing & Kitting QC
• Inwards Quality Control (IQC)

Day 2 – 17th March 2026
Module & System Integration Quality Control
• Prerequisite GNI Course: PCB QA & Reliability – Modules 13, 14
• Module Level QC & Functional Testing
• Cable Harness Quality Inspection
• Subsystem Integration Checks
• System Integration & Environmental Testing
• Final Assessment & Talent Identification

Expected Outcomes
• Exposure to industrial-grade wireless, telecom, and defence quality standards
• Practical assignments
• 15–20 internship/job opportunities

Speakers
• Dr. M. Vishnu Prasad – Strategic HR Division Head, UTS
• Mr. Gatla Raju – Assistant Engineer
• Mr. K. Santosh Kumar – GNI Subject Matter Expert (SME)
